mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_auth_session (session_id, user_id, refresh_token_hash, expires_at, create_time, last_seen_at, ip, user_agent) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{refreshTokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{createTime}, #{lastSeenAt}, #{ip}, #{userAgent})
mapper.select: SELECT session_id, user_id, refresh_token_hash, expires_at, revoked_at, create_time, last_seen_at, ip, user_agent FROM admin_auth_session WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_auth_session SET revoked_at = #{revokedAt} WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE admin_auth_session SET revoked_at = #{revokedAt} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
